title: 3x3 Eyes: Kyuusei Koushu S
overview:
Pai! Yakumo! Haan! The power of their souls resonates!!

An adventure game with an original story that keeps the world of the original work intact. The opening uses TrueMotion to play back high-quality animation!

Based on the 3x3 Eyes manga, Kyuusei Koushu S follows Pai and Yakumo through a new supernatural tale, in which a dark schemer moves to bend the flow of the world's great dragon veins toward a single place. You follow the story through illustrated scenes, talking with characters as the plot unfolds across the city streets.

- Story adventure for one player, memory backup saves
- Two game discs
- A Special CD-ROM made only for the Saturn version: a Hong Kong travelogue with Megumi Hayashibara and Koji Tsujitani

パイが！　八雲が！　ハーンが！
魂の力が共鳴する！！

原作の世界観はそのままのオリジナルストーリーのアドベンチャーゲーム。オープニングはTrue Motionの採用でハイクオリティのアニメーションを再生！
